_comment: For a card that appears ON a screen inside a scene — the studio monitor behind a newsdesk — rather than on a projector in a dark room. This is why the first attempt failed: a 'dark theme' card on a dark set is the same value as the wall behind it, so it stops reading as a lit monitor and becomes floating text. #123A63 measured almost identical to the newsroom's own #26314A panel. The card must be BRIGHTER than the room, not merely a different hue — which is also why every real news channel lights its wall screens: a screen that is not emitting is a screen that is off.
name: Broadcast
